text: 8月境外机构增持中国国债约16亿元人民币，为连续第四个月增持，持有规模升至近2.03万亿元；政策性银行债则小幅增持约6亿元。
text_en: In August, overseas institutions increased their holdings of Chinese government bonds by about RMB 1.6 billion, the fourth consecutive month of increases, with holdings rising to nearly RMB 2.03 trillion; policy bank bonds were slightly increased by about RMB 600 million.
